title: A robot driven by an enum
hints: Matching on a tuple `(self, turn)` turns the eight direction-and-turn combinations into four arms with `|`.

`line.split_once(char::is_whitespace)` separates the command word from the rest at the first white space character; then `match (word, rest)` with a guard handles each form. Matching against string literals needs a `&str`: borrow the lower-cased `String` with `let word: &str = &lower;`.
